verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS scraping API, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented way to export a user's account data (job history, schedules, settings, stored results) in open formats in order to leave. Markdown or HTML output (docs-15) is the product returning scraped pages, not account export, and the bare word 'exports' in the CLI description (docs-38) does not say what is exported or in what format.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
